title.narrative: Output 4.2. Strengthened capacity of enterprises and their support systems to enhance productivity and sustainability

description.narrative: In December 2023, The Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECOP) formally adopts the responsible wage digitization tool and training as part of their regular menu of services and capacity-building programs. In October 2022, the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) signed an MOU with ILO to roll-out digital entrepreneurship and productivity trainings to at least 20,000 micro, small and informal business across all regions in the country through the DTI’s field offices. The trainings for MSMEs include the Start and Improve Your Business (SIYB), Financial Education and Sustaining Competitive and Responsible Enterprises (SCORE). With the support from the Global Centre on Digital Wages for Decent Work, the ILO supported ECOP in the development of guidance tools on wage digitization for small enterprises as well as the conduct of training of trainers utilizing guidance tools developed and webinars. With the support of the Government of Japan, the ILO conducted institutional capacity building and advisory services activities such as Training of Trainers and implementation and sustainability planning. The ILO also contributed in the integration of updated OSH, productivity and digital entrepreneurship training content and methodologies in the current regular programmes of partners.
